title: Ivo and the Cover
author: Xanthe Montrose
blurb: Yara Sandoval, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
